definition: Quantum Merlin Arthur is a complexity class for decision problems whose yes instances have a quantum witness accepted with bounded error by an efficient quantum verifier, while no instances do not.
entry_text: Quantum Merlin Arthur is a complexity class for decision problems whose yes instances have a quantum witness accepted with bounded error by an efficient quantum verifier, while no instances do not.
example: Researchers classify the local Hamiltonian problem by asking what a quantum verifier can establish from a supplied quantum state.
label: Quantum Merlin Arthur
